{{Short description|Swedish biochemist}}[[File:Announcement_Nobelprize_Chemistry_2010-04.jpg|thumb|Lars Thelander]]
'''Lars Thelander''', born 1942, is a [[Sweden|Swedish]] [[biochemist]]. He was awarded a Ph.D. degree at the [[Karolinska Institutet]] in 1968.<ref>Thelander, Lars, ''Studies on thioredoxin reductase from Escherichia coli B'', Diss. (sammanfattning) Stockholm : Karol. inst., Stockholm, 1968 - [http://libris.kb.se/bib/1308986 LIBRIS record]</ref> and is a professor of [[medicinal chemistry|medical chemistry]] and [[biophysics]] at [[Umeå University]].

Thelander is a member of the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences]] since 1994, a member of the [[Nobel Committee for Chemistry]] since 2006 and the Committees chairman since 2010.<ref>[http://nobelprize.org/prize_awarders/chemistry/committee.html Nobelprize.org: The Nobel Committee for Chemistry] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100109111409/http://nobelprize.org/prize_awarders/chemistry/committee.html |date=2010-01-09 }}, accessed 2010-05-28</ref>  In 2004, he delivered the presentation speech for the Nobel Prize in Chemistry.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2004 |url=https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/chemistry/2004/ceremony-speech/ |access-date=2026-07-03 |website=NobelPrize.org |language=en-US}}</ref>
